store.name: Daily Journal – Private Diary
store.subtitle: Time capsules, voice & moods
store.promotionalText: Seal letters to your future self, record voice notes, see your year in moods and turn your journal into a PDF book – private and offline.
store.description:
A private journal with ideas you won't find in a notebook: letters to your future self, your voice, your whole year in colours – and in the end a real book.

Everything stays on your device. No account, no cloud.

TIME CAPSULES
• Seal an entry for 1 month, 6 months, 1 year or 5 years
• It stays locked until the day arrives – not even search can find it
• On the opening day a notification brings your letter back

VOICE NOTES
• Record up to 5 minutes per voice note, right in the entry
• Hear how a day really sounded – stored only on your phone

YOUR YEAR IN MOODS
• One coloured square for every day of the year
• Patterns: your best and hardest weekday, the tags that come with good days, your mood mix

YOUR JOURNAL AS A BOOK
• Export a month, a year or everything as a beautifully set PDF
• Cover page, moods, tags and photos – to print, keep or give away

WRITE THE WAY YOU LIKE
• Lined notebook editor with photos from your gallery or camera
• Mood of the day, tags and automatic drafts
• A new writing prompt every day, templates for gratitude and evening review

LOOK BACK
• "On this day", writing streak, 30-day mood history
• Calendar with mood colours and full-text search

PRIVATE AND SECURE
• PIN lock, optionally with Face ID or fingerprint
• Backup to a file (including voice notes), restore on any device
• Trash: deleted entries can be restored for 30 days
• Four styles: Paper, Minimal, Playful, Night

FREE WITH ADS
The app is free and shows ads. A one-time purchase removes them for good – no subscription. Your entries are never used for advertising.

Available in 14 languages.

today:
Today was one of those days you want to hold on to. We drove to the coast on a whim and watched the sun sink into the water.

What I’m grateful for: this moment, and that I didn’t miss it.
year: First day in the new flat
Boxes everywhere, but it already feels like home.
month: Live music under the open sky – goosebumps.
texts: An hour by the water after work. The air smelled of autumn and for a moment everything was completely still.
We talked about everything that’s on our minds. I’m so glad she’s in my life.
Far too many meetings. Tonight it’s just tea, a blanket and a good book.
Tried pumpkin soup with ginger – making that more often from now on.
The presentation went better than expected. Proud of myself!
Spent the whole afternoon reading and listening to music.
Grandma told stories from the old days again.
capsule: Dear me, one year from now
Right now I'm nervous about the new job. I hope you're laughing about it by now – and that you still go swimming on Sundays.
